title: CoLa-ICD: A Knowledge-Enhanced Framework for Long-Tail Automated Medical Coding
abstract: arXiv:2608.30234v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automatic medical coding assigns ICD codes to clinical notes, but it remains challenging due to long documents, imbalanced label distributions, and diverse terms. These challenges are especially severe for rare codes, which have limited training instances and are easily confused with semantically similar labels. We introduce CoLa-ICD, a knowledge-enhanced framework for long-tail prediction. CoLa-ICD enriches ICD labels with external terms, models dependencies among related codes, and learns stronger alignment between label semantics and clinical evidence for long-tail prediction. Experiments show that CoLa-ICD improves long-tail prediction with larger gains in larger and sparser label spaces and achieves state-of-the-art performance in AUC, F1, and P@k. Our code is available at https://github.com/youwillbethebest/Cola-ICD.

translated_title: CoLa-ICD：一个面向长尾自动医疗编码的知识增强框架
translated_abstract: 自动医疗编码是将ICD编码分配给临床记录的任务，但由于文档过长、标签分布不均衡以及术语多样，该任务仍然充满挑战。这些挑战对于罕见编码尤为严重，因为罕见编码的训练样本有限，且容易与语义相似的标签混淆。我们提出了CoLa-ICD，一个面向长尾预测的知识增强框架。CoLa-ICD利用外部术语丰富ICD标签，建模相关编码之间的依赖关系，并为长尾预测学习标签语义与临床证据之间更强的对齐。实验表明，CoLa-ICD改善了长尾预测效果，在更大、更稀疏的标签空间中提升更为显著，并在AUC、F1和P@k指标上达到了最先进的性能。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/youwillbethebest/Cola-ICD 获取。
tldr: CoLa-ICD通过外部术语增强ICD标签、建模编码间依赖关系并学习标签语义与临床证据的更强对齐，显著提升了自动医疗编码中长尾罕见编码的预测性能。
en_tdlr: CoLa-ICD is a knowledge-enhanced framework that enriches ICD labels with external terms, models dependencies among related codes, and learns stronger alignment between label semantics and clinical evidence, significantly improving long-tail automated medical coding performance.
